_comment: After the three cohort types: sort studies by where the investigation starts. Two of each category, mixing cold cases and the live case.

stem.en: Sort each study into the design its starting point gives it.

text.en: British doctors, all well in 1951, followed for years to count who develops lung cancer
Uranium miners and men who never mined, identified while well and watched for lung cancer
In 1978, the birth records of one Boston hospital for 1969-1975 traced forward to neonatal deaths
Personnel records from 1970 sorted into tank cleaners and others, traced forward to the tumour
20 men with a rare liver tumour and 60 men without it, asked about past tank cleaning
Women with clots and matched women without them, asked about past use of oral contraceptives

explanation.en: In both cohort types the groups are formed by exposure and followed from cause to effect; what differs is where the investigation starts. The doctors' study and the miners' study began while the outcomes still lay ahead. The Boston and personnel-record studies began after the outcomes were already on paper, and only went back far enough to pick up the story. A case-control study instead starts from people who already have the disease and comparable people who do not.

hints.en: Ask on the first day of each study what the investigators already hold: a group sorted by exposure, or a group sorted by disease.
